answer: Unique-Output Mirror Challenge. Each agent identity must answer a fresh, hash-derived task drawn from a shared atlas of past chain state; replaying any prior answer is detected by comparing against a stored mirror of all submitted outputs, so duplicates void the identity. Attackers must generate novel valid work per identity, paying full compute cost each time; copying is free but useless. Registration also requires posting a distinct timber token trace, a one-time hardware signature, making bulk fabrication costly.
